policy_source: Source repository docs/evidence-retention.md; current user preserves the unfinished old verification task.

completed_experiment_full_raw.condition: Selected conclusions, exact firmware/runtime/source identities, reproduction entry points and relevant first-failure/key samples have been readback-verified; no active consumer requires full raw. User authorizes the loss of full raw recoverability.
completed_experiment_full_raw.action: Delete full Flash/source/frame/trace copies; preserve bounded summaries and declared availability status. No indefinite full-raw retention is necessary.

rebuildable_download_or_build_cache.condition: Exact outputs or identical canonical copies are established; no active open file/producer/consumer; source and unique final artifacts are protected.
rebuildable_download_or_build_cache.action: Delete; future use rebuilds or downloads as recorded.

unfinished_task.condition: Task is explicitly ended/cancelled before deleting unique inputs, queued prepared work or progress. A live observer does not establish active guest execution.
unfinished_task.action: Protect the current user decision. Byte-preserving COW optimization can retain all original paths and content without cancelling task.

dirty_source.condition: Changes are committed/pushed or a verified patch and full required untracked assets are safely preserved; working copy is not used.
dirty_source.action: Only then retire the redundant checkout; do not delete a dirty SDK just because it is large.

canonical_runtime_and_disk_chain.condition: No live or planned consumer requires the version/model, or an actually verified equivalent copy exists; all qcow2/backing dependencies accounted for.
canonical_runtime_and_disk_chain.action: Keep one needed copy, remove proven duplicates; do not unlink a unique backing image in isolation.

automatic_expiry: This task does not install a periodic deletion automation. A retention-condition decision is distinct from scheduling destructive cleanup.
